text:
maria_g: Quick sync - I'm drafting the archive design for customer-facing audit log validation. Need WORM + KMS + retention + manifest verification. A few quick Qs below, want to gather edge cases before I write the RFC.

maria_g: Questions: 1) Do we require per-customer CMKs or can we use a service-managed CMK with envelope keys? 2) How strict should Object Lock be (GOV/COMPLIANCE vs governance + legal hold)? 3) What export manifest format do customers need to validate events? 4) How do we prove immutability after key rotation?

jamal: short answers to start: 1) per-customer CMKs preferred for separation/accountability; envelope OK for hosted but complicates proof of immutability in audits. 2) Compliance mode locks down removal — if we need emergency/legal holds that is tricky. 3) manifest = newline-delimited jsonl with file SHA256 + file size + timestamp + signature. 4) store signing key separate from KMS CMK and include key version history in manifest.

alex_k: +1 on per-customer CMK. also: cross-account key grants for customer-owned keys will be needed for private deployments. edge case: customer rotates CMK -> we need to keep old key material's signature chain or sign artifacts with our stable signing key.

sec-bot: Audit: snapshot -> audit-archive-bucket has ObjectLock enabled since 2025-02-01, lifecycle rules: archive -> glacier, retention rule TTL: 7y for high-sensitivity.

sre_ops: cost/ops note: Glacier Deep Archive retrieval is hours; if customers request on-demand validation we need a fast manifest + small sample kept in S3-IA for quick proofing. also lifecycle example:
```
{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "audit-archive-to-deep-archive",
    "Filter": {},
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Transitions": [{"Days": 30, "StorageClass": "GLACIER"}, {"Days": 90, "StorageClass": "DEEP_ARCHIVE"}],
    "NoncurrentVersionExpiration": {"NoncurrentDays": 3650}
  }]
}
```

sre_ops: fallback: keep a signed, compact manifest (hash + index) in a hot bucket encrypted with a stable signing key so verification doesn't require full restore.

compliance_team: For customer-facing validation API we expect: 1) API returns signed manifest URL + signature 2) manifest contains event-level SHA256 3) verification guide for customers (sample code). We need SLA commitment on how quickly we return a verification (e.g., 48h for full restore, <5min for manifest).

legal: legal hold process: we cannot allow automated removal of Compliance-mode Object Lock. Any removal/override must be manual, logged, and require >=2 approvals (legal + CISO). also need an audit trail for key grant requests.

maria_g: here's a minimal manifest schema I'm proposing:
```json
{"manifest_version":"1.0","generated_at":"2025-05-06T15:00:00Z","archive_bucket":"redwood-audit-archives/customer-123","files":[{"path":"2025/05/05/0001.log.gz","sha256":"<hex>","size":12345,"signed_by":"redwood-signing-v1"}],"signatures":[{"key_id":"signing-v1","sig":"<base64>"}]}
```

alex_k: small nit: include KMS key id(s) and key policy reference in manifest metadata, e.g. `kms_keys:[{"customer_cmk":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc"}]` so auditors can tie objects -> keys.

jamal: edge-case: customer requests proof after we rotated signing key. include a `signing_key_history` array with previous key ids and signatures over manifest chain. and timestamped revocation list.

compliance_team: SLA suggestion: manifest availability = realtime (hot store); full-object retrieval SLA = 48-72h for deep archived items, expedited at cost. provide a signed "integrity stamp" that customers can store locally and verify without restoring.

legal: also document process for lawful access: any request to remove legal hold -> requires court order + legal ticket, we must record chain of custody for removable flags.

maria_g: Action items: 1) write RFC w/ design + manifest schema (owner: me) 2) KMS key model decision (per-customer vs service) (owner: @jamal) 3) signing key scheme + rotation policy (owner: @alex_k) 4) legal/ops runbook for holds (owner: @legal) 5) implement hot manifest store & sample verification API (owner: @sre_ops + compliance).

maria_g: Can folks ack and add anything I'm missing? planning a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize RFC scope. :calendar:

jamal: ack

alex_k: ack

sre_ops: ack

compliance_team: adding: include sample verification snippets in SDK + threat model for manifest signing key compromise.

legal: will draft hold/override runbook and checklist.

sec-bot: note: created task #ENGSEC-4321 for RFC follow-up.
